0022600212.text: The Boston Celtics (8-2, on a three-game winning streak and 2nd in the East) visit the Philadelphia 76ers (9-2, 1st in the East and the Atlantic) in the Celtics' 11th game of the season, with Boston 3-2 on the road and Philadelphia 4-1 at home. The 76ers are missing Adem Bona (back, sprain), Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), all listed as out. The teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2 and met in the 2025-26 playoffs, where the Celtics lost 3-4, and their most recent meeting was a 109-100 Philadelphia win in Boston on May 2, 2026.
